staticText: Local-first Nigerian Pidgin learning phrasebook with 109 embedded rows across 9 categories, bidirectional session-only flashcards, filtered local export and optional external translation after explicit page-session consent.
boundaries: Nigerian Pidgin wording and non-standardised spelling vary by region, community, register and speaker.
Do not present this phrasebook as one authoritative Nigerian Pidgin or African Pidgin standard.
Cameroonian Pidgin English and Ghanaian Pidgin are related but distinct varieties and are not covered by this dataset.
Phrase-level source, region, speaker community, register, checked date and verified pronunciation are missing; label those gaps instead of inferring them.
Browser speech is a synthetic convenience preview and must not be described as verified pronunciation.
Never place raw source or translated text in browser persistence, URLs, analytics, accounts, email, logs or caches.
